text.9:84: And never (O Muhammad) pray for one of them who dieth, nor stand by his grave. Lo! they disbelieved in Allah and His messenger, and they died while they were evil-doers.
text.22:7: And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves.
text.35:22: Nor are the living equal with the dead. Lo! Allah maketh whom He will to hear. Thou canst not reach those who are in the graves.
text.60:13: O ye who believe! Be not friendly with a folk with whom Allah is wroth, (a folk) who have despaired of the Hereafter as the disbelievers despair of those who are in the graves.
text.100:9: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
